_help: Act 1, the offer, with encounter B: Karim Fahmy meets you; armed men burst in for his case. With musa_respect, Musa is one of them and won't shoot; talking them down works if Umm Sayed warned you about Finch (warned_finch: you know the police watch him); 20 buys them off; drawing: event fight_armed_men (end_fight). When act1.gd wins that fight it sets act1_gunfight_won and act1_confrontation_done and starts this talk again, which resumes at the offer. Accepting: +50 (75 if you pushed), act1_offer_accepted, the fragment's journal clue (end_accepted). Then Act 2. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

intro.speaker: karim
intro.line: Karim Fahmy. I represent Sir Reginald Blackwood. He has heard you are a man who keeps expeditions alive. Please, sit.

case.speaker: karim
case.line: In this case is the reason I asked for you. But first...

armed.speaker: gunman
armed.line: Nobody move. The case, effendi. Slide it over, and nobody has to bleed on the tablecloth.

musa_there.speaker: musa
musa_there.line: Wait. This one... this one helped me stand up. I do not shoot him.

musa_leaves.speaker: gunman
musa_leaves.line: Musa! Idiot! ...Fine. Fine! This isn't finished, Fahmy.

talk_down.speaker: player
talk_down.line: Three of them. Pistols out. The leader's hand isn't steady.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.line: You don't want this. Look around: one shot and every policeman in Cairo comes running. Walk away.

choices.label: Offer him money
choices.line: Twenty pounds to forget you ever saw this case.

talk_works.speaker: gunman
talk_works.line: ...Police. Right. You're Finch's problem anyway, not mine. Let's go.

choices.label: Offer him money
choices.line: All right, all right. Twenty pounds, and you walk.

bribe.speaker: gunman
bribe.line: Twenty, and the case stays. Generous man. Enjoy your lunch.

avoided.speaker: karim
avoided.line: ...Well. Mr. Blackwood was right about you.

resume.speaker: karim
resume.line: My hands are still shaking. Mr. Blackwood was right about you. Now, the case.

offer.speaker: karim
offer.line: A fragment of an inscription, and part of a map. Sir Reginald believes they lead to the tombs of Akmentar. He wants you to lead the expedition.

menu.speaker: karim
menu.line: Fifty pounds now, for your... present difficulties. A great deal more if the tombs are found.

choices.label: Ask about the first expedition
choices.line: This isn't Blackwood's first try, is it?

choices.label: Ask about the reward
choices.line: How much is a great deal?

choices.label: Ask for more up front
choices.line: Fifty doesn't cover the men who just pointed guns at me.

choices.label: Accept
choices.line: All right. I'll take your expedition.

first.speaker: karim
first.line: There was an earlier expedition. It did not return. What happened to it is Sir Reginald's affair, and he does not discuss it.

reward.speaker: karim
reward.line: Five thousand pounds when the tombs are found and documented. Enough to make Mr. Mallory's debts look very small.

more.speaker: karim
more.line: ...Seventy-five, then. And Sir Reginald will hear that you drive a hard bargain.

refuse.speaker: karim
refuse.line: Then consider this: the men who came for this case today will not stop at me. They know your face now.

accept.speaker: karim
accept.line: Excellent. The expedition fund will be at the bank in the morning. You leave Cairo in two days, ready or not.

pay_finch.speaker: player
pay_finch.line: Fifty pounds in my pocket, and Finch wants fifty.

choices.label: Pay Finch off
choices.line: Might as well start the job with a clean slate.
